pattern_rationale: STUB FIXTURE. The LIS has no API and no event feed, and its schema is small and stable, so read-only SQL on a schedule is the least invasive option.

alternatives_considered.why_not: The system exposes no API to wrap.
Would need the vendor to add an export job; the data is already queryable.

sync.detail: Every 15 minutes, filtered on RSLT_DTTM once a high-water mark is kept.

field_map.transform: F -> female, M -> male, else unknown

resources.source_entity: LAB_RSLT joined to TEST_REF and PT_MSTR

field_map.transform: F -> final, P -> preliminary, C -> corrected
H, L, N copied as v3 interpretation codes

risks: Direct SQL couples the fabric to the vendor schema.
Polling load on the production database.
human_review_points: Timestamps are assumed to be UTC.
Lab Patient records duplicate EHR demographics; the gateway keeps one Patient per MRN.
